M23.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。
M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery.
M23.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收、绝对原创性及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。反复可中断变化中的证书维持仍未实现。
M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance, absolute priority and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. Maintaining certificates through repeated interruptible changes remains open.

M23.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. M23.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved.
